payload.name: ExtractUserItemDescriptions
payload.description: When a user shares a photo or link and adds a qualitative description of an owned object, pet, or recent purchase, during extraction create a memory candidate for the description before judging it trivial.
content: During candidate extraction, treat short evaluative statements about the user's own items (e.g., new purchases, pets, home improvements) as memory candidates even when they accompany a photo or casual message.
Extract the description as a preference or state fact only if it conveys a durable quality or opinion the user would want recalled (e.g., 'super cozy and comfy').
Skip statements that are temporary, purely conversational, or not tied to a concrete object the user owns or uses; do not expand one mention into multiple memories.

solves: General failure mechanism: the construction pipeline skips extraction for user messages that attach a brief qualitative description to an image or link, so durable evaluative facts about owned items are never persisted. Applies to future sessions where a user posts a photo of an object, pet, or purchase and states its qualities in the same message. Does not apply to ordinary statements already covered by base extraction, to purely conversational feedback without a durable object, or to temporary states such as 'it is warm today'.
